task: The environment may have changed. Revise your current model using the six recent observed transitions, preserving unchanged rules. Do not assume a visible version field or ask for test answers.

interface.observation: Complete visible business records plus filter/sort/selected/role/feedback/visible_ids. Rule version is not observed.
interface.format: Each action is a JSON object with type and the parameters above. Infer conditions and effects from evidence, not from task names.
interface.delta: Only changed top-level keys are listed; issue_updates contains id and changed fields. Unlisted fields stay unchanged. This is an exact lossless encoding, not a description of rules.

output_contract: Write only a standalone Python module defining predict(state:dict, action:dict)->dict. Return the complete next observation. Do not read files, use tools for external information, call a model at prediction time or hardcode example IDs. Only copy/json/math/re/typing/collections/itertools/functools imports are allowed. Save uncertainty and rule notes in a module docstring. Evidence fields are exhaustive for these experiments; do not invent inaccessible latent state.
